boundary_evidence: NOT FROM tu_map. tools/tu_map.py reports the arm9 `main` module as UNDER-SEGMENTED: one unit covering the whole module text with dozens of class labels, so there is no tu_map boundary or `tubuild.py create` candidate id here; every line below is hand-derived and independently checkable.

contiguous linker run 0x02015d38..0x0201609c: the seven delinks entries tiled 0x02015d38..0x02015ebc and 0x02015ef4..0x0201609c; the 0x38-byte hole 0x02015ebc..0x02015ef4 is this TU's two previously unenrolled members InitCylinder (0x02015ebc) and InitCuboid (0x02015ed8), so the full span is one class's code with no foreign bytes.

class-label homogeneity: every named symbol in the run is a member of dExtShadowModel_c (the ModelBase sibling for drop shadows in include/dExtShadowModel_c.h). InitCylinder and InitCuboid are `bx ip` tail calls into the inherited SetFile dispatcher, which is why their shard-style sources existed untracked by delinks while the run still tiles exactly once they are folded in.

ROM evidence says one object: the emitted vtable lands at 0x0208e868 (_ZTV17dExtShadowModel_c) whose slots read [D1 0x02015ff8, D0 0x02015f80, DoSetFile 0x02015ef4] -- all inside this run; the cartridge's _ZTI17dExtShadowModel_c (0x0208e770) and _ZTS17dExtShadowModel_c (0x0208e888) name this same class, and the vtable preamble's typeinfo word points at it; those records sit in data this TU does not own.

neighbour below: _ZN15dExtFrameCtrl_cC2Ev at 0x02015d18..0x02015d38 (Animation, a different class). Neighbour above: _ZN17dExtCommonModel_c12SetPolygonIDEj at 0x0201609c (dExtCommonModel_c, a sibling class). The run is bracketed rather than cut out of a uniform stretch.

compiler_only_output.reason: Base-subobject variant of the complete-object ctor _ZN17dExtShadowModel_cC1Ev (0x02016068): mwcc emits both from one out-of-line ctor, nothing constructs dExtShadowModel_c as a base subobject in the retail image, and no configured symbol names this copy.
Compiler-generated base-object destructor. The cartridge carries D1 at 0x02015ff8 and D0 at 0x02015f80; no symbols.txt row defines a D2 and nothing relocates to one.

mwccarm re-emits Vector3's trivial vague-linkage D1 alongside the licensed text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, kind:function(arm,size=0x4), owned by an enrolled source; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.
compiler-emitted vtable (two-word ABI preamble + slots D1=0x02015ff8 D0=0x02015f80 DoSetFile=0x02015ef4); canonical bytes verified, contribution is gap data

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dCc_c and arm9/dWipe_c entries, which took the same route.

InitModel's mangled name carries 5Fix12IiES3_S3_ -- a real Fix12<int> by-value signature. The definition stays a mangled free function under `#pragma cplusplus off` because CW homes class-typed by-value parameters to the stack (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md); the header's declaration is the true signature and callers emit the same S3_ symbol either way.

_ZN17dExtShadowModel_c9DoSetFileEPcii is the key function: the vtable emits from this TU and is licensed deadstrip-data at its configured home 0x0208e868. The cartridge does carry _ZTI17dExtShadowModel_c (0x0208e770) and _ZTS17dExtShadowModel_c (0x0208e888), but neither is enrolled as this TU's data, so records emitted here would have no configured home; the TU compiles with #pragma RTTI off and no RTTI rows exist to license.

InitCylinder/InitCuboid sit in config/rombuild-exclude.txt's history: as standalone shards they referenced arm9's symbols.txt names data_020ad524/data_020ad560 -- addresses past .bss that no link object defines, so mwldarm rejected the carved objects. The addresses' owning module is the shared overlay-0/1 region (relocs.txt tags the targets module:overlays(0,1)); spelling the externs data_ov000_020ad524/data_ov000_020ad560 resolves them, and the two symbols came off the exclude list when the TU folded them in.
